notes.title: Duped v1.0.5
notes.notes:
Howdy everybody,
We're pushing live Duped v1.0.5. This version contains a number of tweaks & improvements to try and maximise the amount of fun you get out of the game.

Changes:
-Added a new UI to make it more obvious how many clones you can have per level.
-Fixed up two places where it was previously possible to become stuck
-Changed the save file system to be more robust (allows for more saving features to be easily added in future updates)
-Tweaked level 1-5 to more effectively teach what it was trying to teach to the player
-Tweaked one of the levels in the Theseus Demo to make it slightly easier.

notes.title: New Duped Version
notes.notes:
Hey guys!
So, somebody reported that they were having a problem with the save system in Duped. It seems that if you played the demo before purchasing the full game, Duped wasn't correctly able to load your game.

This bug has been fixed. Your save file should be migrated over to the new system, meaning that unless you already noticed this bug, you won't see any changes.

If you lost your save file due to this bug, feel free to reach out and I'll give you instructions on how to restore it.

Reuben Moorhouse
@NoMossStudios
